Definition: Integration of CRVS data (births, deaths, marriages) into data exchange for real-time verification and service eligibility
Comments: The Civil Status Department operates a unified digital database accessible nationwide. Birth certificates, death certificates, marriage/divorce records are digitized and available through the Digital Egypt Portal and smart civil registry machines. Ministry of Interior validates national IDs and issues electronic birth/marital certificates linked to the social protection MIS.

Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: National ID number is used as primary identifier linked to digital systems including social protection (Takaful/Karama), civil registration, and the Digital Egypt portal. The Haweya digital ID platform (launched Nov 2025 by CBE) for eKYC is under deployment. National digital ID for government services fully integrated is still under development.

Definition: Integration of health records, patient registration, immunization data, and health insurance into data exchange
Comments: Egypt launched DHIS2 as national health information system (Jan 2026), National Digital Health Strategy 2025-2029, Universal Health Insurance System (UHIS) with 4.5 million+ EHR records and 255+ automated family medicine centres, and Sehat Misr platform. Health data partially integrated with national digital ecosystem; full interoperability under development.

Comments: InstaPay (16 million users), Meeza national card (43.5 million cards), mobile wallets (55.5 million accounts), and G2P payments via Meeza cards for Takaful/Karama social protection (4.7 million households). Comments: Takaful and Karama program uses a social registry of ~12 million households linked to national ID, with MIS linking databases from Ministry of Interior (ID validation), Ministry of Health (health conditionalities), Ministry of Planning (unified national registry). Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: Law No. 15 of 2004 (Electronic Signatures); Law No. 151 of 2020 (Personal Data Protection Law, with Executive Regulations issued Nov 2025); Presidential Council of Ministers Decision No. 856/2010 on data sharing between government entities. Legislation for cross-government data sharing exists but enforcement and implementation are still maturing.

Definition: Whether a detailed implementation roadmap with phases, milestones, and timelines exists for data exchange development
Comments: Egypt Vision 2030 and the Digital Egypt ICT 2030 Strategy contain phased implementation milestones including supplying all 32,000 government entities with fiber optic by 2030, and the Digital Health Strategy 2025-2029 provides sectoral roadmap. Comprehensive public roadmap for data exchange specifically is partially documented.

Definition: Whether a formal strategy or policy document exists specifically for government data exchange and interoperability
Comments: Egypt has a comprehensive Digital Egypt Strategy under MCIT aligned with Vision 2030, explicitly including digital transformation and interoperability as strategic pillars. Data exchange and government interoperability are core elements. Digital Transformation is listed as one of seven enablers in Egypt's Vision 2030.

Definition: Is artificial intelligence integrated into the data exchange for data quality, fraud detection or predictive analytics
Comments: AI is planned/early-stage for government data exchange. MCIT signed MoUs with IBM for generative AI in government institutions and with Huawei for AI capabilities. CBE I-Score uses AI-driven credit scoring. National AI Strategy (2021) identifies AI as priority for public services but no documented AI integration specifically within government data exchange layer.

Definition: Extent to which the data exchange enables services accessible to all population groups including persons with disabilities, elderly, low literacy
Comments: Digital Egypt portal lacks features supporting access for people with disabilities (noted by Masaar analysis). National Academy for IT for Persons with Disabilities exists, and Decent Life initiative benefits 58 million citizens in 4,500 villages. Accessibility improvements are in progress but not yet comprehensive.

Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020 prohibits cross-border data transfers without authorization. Executive Regulations No. 816/2025 (entered force Nov 2025) establish comprehensive licensing regime for cross-border transfers. Government strategy includes plans for data localization and national data hubs. Enforcement is still being built up (Personal Data Protection Center not fully independent).

Definition: Whether data exchange infrastructure and services reach rural and remote areas or concentrate in urban centers
Comments: Significant digital divide exists between urban and rural areas acknowledged in Egypt Vision 2030. Decent Life initiative extends fiber optic to 4,500 villages, 1,367 mobile towers built in rural areas. Internet penetration at 81.9% nationally (2025) but rural access lags. Partial rural coverage underway.
